_comment: Common English vocabulary for the corpus validator (COMMON_VOCABULARY rule) and the difficulty derivation. BUILD-TIME ONLY - never shipped to a client and never part of puzzle text. See corpus/SOURCING.md for provenance.

provenance.core: The 6000 most frequent word types across 25 public-domain Project Gutenberg texts (2.42M tokens), keeping only words that occur in at least 3 of the 25 books so book-specific names and jargon drop out. Stored in descending frequency order, so the array index is the frequency rank. Word counts over a public-domain corpus are facts we measured ourselves, not a licensed third-party frequency list.
provenance.everyday: Hand-authored supplement of ordinary modern vocabulary that pre-1930 prose does not contain (appliances, groceries, traffic, phones, work, signage). Written for this project. Treated as rank EVERYDAY_RANK by the difficulty scorer.
provenance.contractions: Common English contractions with the apostrophe stripped, matching the validator tokenizer.
